notes: CRITICAL PAPER STRUCTURE NOTE: Kocira 2019 is titled 'Effect of amino acid biostimulant' but contains TWO distinct treatment arms: (1) Terra Sorb Complex (amino acid biostimulant, concentrations 0.3% and 0.5%, single and double spray) and (2) Kelpak (seaweed extract SWE, doses 0.7 and 1.0 L/ha, single and double spray), across 3 years (2014, 2015, 2016). Li 2022 classified BOTH arms as 'Kelpak/SWE' in their database. Our extractor only captured the Terra Sorb Complex arm (12 seed yield observations). The Kelpak seaweed arm (12 GT rows, pairs 51-62, labeled 'Kelpak ' with trailing space) was missed entirely — this is the main coverage failure for this paper. Unit scaling: Li 2022 GT ctrl_means are 10x smaller than our JSON values (e.g., GT 0.3267 vs JSON 3.267 t/ha) — effect percentages are identical, confirming matches. GT pair 65 appears to be a data entry error in Li 2022 (treat < ctrl inconsistently, all other arms show positive effects).
